text:
Asha: quick RFC follow-up 0min: do we default tenant private connectivity to direct endpoints in customer VPCs or to our tenant-proxy? need clear default + health/fallback semantics.

Ben: direct = simplest for customers who require preserved source IPs and minimal infra on our side. downside: explosion of ENIs/peering entries and harder rollout for infra changes.

Ravi: proxy = operationally nicer: single fleet to patch, trace, and apply batching/caching. extra hop adds latency and egress cost. fallback story is much cleaner.

Maya: SRE input: direct has zero internal single-point-of-failure but customer misconfigurations can cause long outages. proxy gives us automatic failover to hosted paths.

Asha: propose a concrete default: prefer direct when healthy, auto-fail to proxy on health/latency errors. allow explicit flags: direct-only (egress-ip-preserve) and proxy-only (data-residency/compliance).

Ben: numbers to start: prefer direct if sustained <200 rps and <6k tokens/min. flip to proxy for sustained >200 rps or if customer requests caching.

Ravi: failure detector idea: monitor p95(path) and error-rate. if proxy p95 >120ms for 30s OR error-rate >1.5% for 1m, mark proxy degraded and route attempts to direct when available. also circuit-break proxy when CPU >75% cluster-wide.

Maya: ops checklist: tag traces with path=direct|proxy, record proxy instance id, dashboards for split-rate and p95 by customer, runbook to force route override.

Asha: cert modes: support (1) mTLS end-to-end (proxy TCP passthrough), (2) TLS terminate at proxy with attestation token to control plane. document tradeoffs in appendix.

Ben: sales note: include cost comparison in appendix so solutions can recommend mode during onboarding.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-3601: "Tenant connectivity default decision 1: prefer-direct-with-proxy-fallback" assigned to Asha, Ravi, Ben, Maya.

Ravi: i'll prototype failover state machine and a small sim this week; will post numbers here.

Asha: thanks all 1 will draft the decision appendix and onboarding checkbox updates by Thu.
